app.title: Ferry
app.emptyHint: Drag game files onto this window or click to choose. Select all parts at once.
app.drop: Drop to add to the queue.
app.discoverHint: Searches for PS5 on the local network (ports 2121 and 1337)
app.gamesFolderHint: Each game goes into a folder with its name under this path. M.2 = /mnt/ext1/homebrew · internal SSD = /data/homebrew
app.exfatHint: Images keep their filenames in this folder. It must be a folder scanned by ShadowMount+ (default: /data/homebrew, /mnt/ext1/homebrew, /mnt/usbN…).
app.webhookUrlHint: HTTP/HTTPS URL of the webhook or ntfy topic
app.webhookHint: Notifies when a transfer finishes, fails or needs a password. No automatic retries. In Automatic mode, follows the Windows language. The URL may contain a token; protect settings.json.
app.watchHint: Optional. Games arriving here automatically join the queue when all parts arrive.
app.connectionsHint: Small files transfer in parallel; large files use one connection while being extracted.
app.passwordsHint: one per line, tried before asking
app.passwordsTooltip: A password that works in the dialog is automatically added here.
app.languageHint: Automatic follows the Windows language. Other languages use English.
app.hostInvalid: Enter the PS5 IP address or hostname without spaces.
app.portInvalid: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
app.imageDirInvalid: Enter a PS5 path starting with / (for example: /mnt/ext1/homebrew).
app.foundHint: Found {0}. Click "Use this one" in the sidebar.
app.notFound: No PS5 found on the network.
app.foundConfiguredLog: PS5 found at the already configured IP address
app.foundConfigured: An FTP server responds at the already configured IP address and port.
app.filesDropped: {0} file(s) added by drag and drop
app.shutdownAfter: Shut down this PC when transfers finish (this session)
app.powerHint: PKG uploaded or installation requested means transfer finished; installation on the PS5 is not confirmed. New or removed work cancels shutdown.
app.keepAwake: Keep this PC awake while sending (this session)
app.powerOff: Shutdown is off. Add pending work to enable it.
app.powerWaiting: Armed for this session. Waiting for all transfers to succeed; pauses, errors, missing parts, passwords and uncertain results block shutdown.
app.powerCountdown: This PC will shut down in {0} seconds. Cancel here or close Ferry.
app.powerCancelled: PC shutdown cancelled. Enable it again for pending work if needed.
app.powerQueueChanged: Work changed. PC shutdown cancelled; enable it again for pending work.
app.powerUnobserved: Shutdown blocked: new work has not appeared in the queue yet, or sources could not be checked.
app.powerRequested: Shutdown of this PC requested. Windows may ask you to save open apps.
app.powerFailed: The Windows power action could not be confirmed. Shutdown is disarmed in Ferry; check this PC before enabling it again.
